SAMPLE DATA | All company IDs, figures, addresses, bank details and names in this workbook are fictional placeholders.
Funding vs procurement | A grant/funding application and a procurement/tender are different processes. The exact documents depend on the scheme, department, tender and contract.
Legal review | Have an Indian corporate/procurement lawyer and CA/CS review the final submission before signing or filing.
Environmental compliance | WaterManager is a software/data platform; actual treated-water discharge/reuse must meet applicable technical, environmental and municipal requirements.
Data protection | If the platform processes personal data, privacy/security terms should be aligned with applicable law, including the DPDP framework and applicable rules.
